hook: Who's telling the truth about Hormuz mines?
caption:
🛢️ Hormuz: Iran says tankers hit mines, the US says the routes are clear. Oil prices can feel it.
💸 Binance says it will cover all losses from the $6.3B hack, the biggest crypto theft on record.
🗳️ Over 43 million Americans have already voted. Election Day is Tuesday 3 November.
🚌 Hundreds evacuated from occupied Oleshky under a one-town ceasefire.
🎃 Houdini died on Halloween, 100 years ago today.

Which story surprised you most?

Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.

1/5 Hormuz: mines or no mines? (1/5)
Iran says tankers hit mines; US says routes are clear. About a fifth of the world's oil normally passes here.

2/5 Binance promises to pay it back ($6.3B)
Binance says it'll cover all losses from a $6.3B hack. It's the largest crypto theft on record.
📷 Edwin.images (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

3/5 43 million already voted (43M)
Over 43 million have voted early, nearly 10M above 2022. Tuesday's vote decides which party controls Congress.

4/5 Out of Oleshky, via Belarus
Hundreds left occupied Oleshky under a one-town ceasefire. They'd gone months without regular food and medicine.
